locative compound denoting the realm of residence

items.question: What duration and realm of residence result from the prescribed worship across ages?
premises: Worship performed in different ages yields a specific fruit.
The resulting fruit includes residence in the heavenly world.
This residence extends for thousands of ages.
items.inference: Therefore, the prescribed worship grants prolonged residence in the heavenly realm.
items.plain_english: One would dwell in the heavenly world for thousands of ages.
